title: DoctrineSource
description: SAIA-Class S doctrinal source representing raw, uncompiled doctrinal text used by the Doctrine Compiler.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier for this doctrinal source (UUID recommended).

version.description: Version label for this doctrinal source (semantic, date-based, or sovereign revision code).

title.description: Human-readable title of the doctrinal document.

text.description: Raw doctrinal text exactly as authored. This is the input to the Doctrine Compiler.

author.description: Name or identifier of the doctrinal author (sovereign, delegate, or system).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the doctrinal source was created.
